text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio had to give up on the 
Kikuka-sho. However, never giving up on 
her future, she continued training for her 
next dream.

Reporting this to Nice Nature and the 
others, they decided to build up their 
strength in preparation for Tokai Teio's 
comeback.

Furthermore, Matikane Tannhauser joins the 
team! Twin Turbo is full of energy, ready 
to show her the way out of her slump.

The next goal is "Place top 3 in 3 GIII or 
higher races" by next May. Additionally, 
aiming for this year's Arima Kinen might 
also be a good idea.
